DIAGNOSIS READY: Interstitial Cystitis/Bladder Pain Syndrome (IC/BPS).

The negative cystoscopy, absence of infection, and relief of symptoms with voiding despite normal imaging are classic for IC/BPS. The mild proteinuria may be incidental or related to stress, but the clinical picture strongly points to this diagnosis.
